term.def: Zero data retention means an AI provider processes your data but does not store it afterwards, so nothing sits on their servers later.

prompt.prompt: Review our contract with [AI vendor name] and list exactly what it says about storing, retaining or deleting our company data.

quiz.q: Business Standard reports that Anthropic introduced a zero data retention option for firms using advanced AI.
quiz.why: This is what the headline states about Anthropic's new offering for business users.

quiz.q: ET Datacenters reports that India tops a digital sovereignty index but struggles with AI control.
quiz.why: This directly reflects what the headline says about India's ranking and challenge.

quiz.q: AI models understand language the same way humans do, with real comprehension and feelings.
quiz.why: AI predicts likely word patterns from data. It has no understanding, feelings or awareness.

quiz.q: AI tools can sound completely confident while giving an answer that is factually wrong.
quiz.why: This is a well known limitation. Confidence in tone never guarantees accuracy, so checking matters.

quiz.q: Once an AI model is trained, it never needs to be updated or retrained again.
quiz.why: Models can go stale as information changes, so providers regularly retrain or update them.
